[ENVIRONMENT]
Photorealistic modern Tokyo after rainfall.

Shibuya: LED billboards, Japanese signs, taxis, umbrellas, glass buildings and elevated railways.

[CAMERA]
High-speed cinematic chase.

Wheels spin rapidly and remain grounded.
Body reacts naturally to turns, jumps and landings.
Rabbit ears and jacket flap strongly in the wind.
No slow-motion floating.

[SEQUENCE]

0–3 sec — SHIBUYA CROWD
Open instantly in a crowded Shibuya pedestrian area.
The character is already skateboarding at high speed.
Low camera skims above wet pavement as the character carves between pedestrians with transparent umbrellas.
People move aside naturally.
The board cuts through puddles, spraying water.
Neon lights streak behind and wet reflections stretch into light trails.
The character crouches and accelerates toward the roadway.

Camera drops behind the skateboard.
The character weaves between taxis and cars, passing extremely close to one vehicle.
Water sprays from tires, headlights streak across wet asphalt.
The character uses a small road barrier as a ramp and launches toward the railway.

A Tokyo commuter train rushes past on the neighboring track.
The wheels briefly grind along the rail, producing sparks.
Side tracking shot with strong train motion blur.
The character crouches deeply and performs a powerful ollie toward an elevated structure.

9–12 sec — EXPRESSWAY
The character lands smoothly on an elevated Tokyo expressway and accelerates.
Reveal a breathtaking Tokyo skyline with towers, elevated roads and traffic below.
Camera swings from rear chase to front-side tracking.
The character races beside cars at extreme speed as street lamps flash overhead.
Ahead is a tall residential tower.
The expressway rises near it and the character aims toward the building.

12–15 sec — HIGH-RISE HOME

Pull back briefly to reveal the character flying above Tokyo, with Shibuya lights, traffic, railways and wet streets below.
The character flies toward an upper-floor balcony of a high-rise apartment with the doors already open.
The skateboard lands perfectly on the wet balcony.
The character NEVER gets off the skateboard and rolls directly inside.
Camera follows behind.

Hold for 0.5 sec.

Photorealistic global illumination.
Realistic wet reflections, city haze, cloth motion, skateboard physics, wheel rotation, vehicles and landing impacts.
Sharp character with controlled background motion blur.
The entire video must feel like ONE continuous journey:
crowd → roadway → railway → expressway → high-rise apartment.
Every transition must come from the character's physical movement.
No random cuts or teleportation.

Do not change cyan left X / pink right X.
No human face or visible skin.
Do not remove rabbit ears.
Do not change jacket, shoes or skateboard.
No extra limbs, deformed hands/feet or disappearing wheels.
No floating or running.
Character stays on the skateboard for the entire journey.
No anime, fantasy city, heavy cyberpunk, captions, logos, UI or watermarks.

subject_definitions:

summary:

[reference generation] The target video is a 15-second comedic Japanese 2D anime short featuring <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> competing to eat an absurdly enormous parfait as fast as possible inside a stylish Japanese dessert café. The comedy comes from their excessively serious rivalry, rapid but simple spoon-to-mouth eating, exaggerated facial reactions, whipped cream covering their faces, and a final misunderstanding where <Subject 1> celebrates after stealing the last strawberry even though most of the giant parfait is still uneaten.

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - preserve the recognizable face, pale-blue eyes, platinum-white hair, rabbit-ear headgear, colorful headphones, dark-purple clothing, accessories, proportions, and mischievous expressions of <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. Any weapon accessories remain secured and are never touched or used.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - preserve the recognizable face, pale-blue eyes, long black hair, rabbit-ear headgear, turquoise clothing, accessories, proportions, and competitive expressions of <Subject 2> from <Picture 2>. Any weapon accessories remain secured and are never touched or used.

detailed_description:

The target video uses polished Japanese theatrical 2D anime animation with expressive character acting, clean linework, colorful food illustration, smooth facial animation, strong comic timing, and exaggerated reaction faces. Keep the physical actions simple and readable. The humor should come from expressions, pauses, dialogue, and visual contrast rather than complicated action choreography.

[Shot 1] In a stylish Japanese dessert café, <Subject 1> (S1) sits on the left side of a small table and <Subject 2> (S2) sits on the right. Between them stands an absurdly enormous parfait nearly one meter tall, overflowing with vanilla ice cream, chocolate ice cream, strawberries, bananas, colorful fruit, whipped cream, cookies, wafers, chocolate sauce, and one perfect strawberry at the very top. Both girls hold oversized dessert spoons and stare intensely at each other as though preparing for a championship match. The camera slowly pushes toward their serious faces. <Subject 1> grins and says, <d>[Japanese] 先に食べ切った方が勝ちね。</d> <Subject 2> confidently answers, <d>[Japanese] 余裕。</d> A small service bell rings.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a steady medium two-shot. Both girls immediately begin eating the parfait extremely quickly but with clear, simple repeated motions: scoop, mouth, scoop, mouth. Their cheeks gradually puff out. Whipped cream appears on <Subject 1>'s nose and on <Subject 2>'s cheek. Use several quick visual beats while keeping both characters seated and their positions consistent. The upper layers of the parfait visibly decrease. Their expressions become increasingly desperate while they continue pretending everything is under control. <Subject 2> briefly looks sideways at <Subject 1>; <Subject 1> notices and eats one extra spoonful with a smug grin.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.500, cut to a close-up of the top of the parfait. Only one beautiful strawberry remains visible above the whipped cream. Both oversized spoons stop at exactly the same moment on either side of the strawberry. Silence. Cut to both girls staring at it with comically intense expressions. <Subject 1> slowly smiles and asks, <d>[Japanese] 半分こする？</d> <Subject 2> relaxes slightly and answers, <d>[Japanese] いいよ。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:11.500, before <Subject 2> can react, <Subject 1> calmly scoops up the entire strawberry and pops it into her mouth. She raises both fists in victory, cheeks full, and happily shouts, <d>[Japanese] 勝ったー！</d> <Subject 2> freezes with a completely blank expression. After one silent beat, she slowly points downward. The camera tilts down to reveal that the giant parfait glass is still more than half full below the tabletop. <Subject 2> deadpans, <d>[Japanese] まだ半分あるけど。</d> <Subject 1>'s triumphant smile instantly freezes. End on her wide-eyed embarrassed expression with whipped cream still on her nose.

overall_soundscape:

Warm indoor café ambience remains subtle throughout the video. Use clear dessert-spoon clinks against glass, soft scooping sounds, quick comedic eating sounds, small chair movements, cloth rustle, and the opening service-bell ding. During [Shot 2], rhythmic spoon and eating sounds become faster without becoming chaotic. At the beginning of [Shot 3], abruptly reduce the sound to near silence to emphasize the final strawberry. Add a tiny soft bite sound when <Subject 1> eats the strawberry, followed by a brief silent pause before <Subject 2>'s final line. Japanese dialogue is clear, expressive, natural, and synchronized with each character.

non_diegetic_music:

A playful high-tempo Japanese anime comedy score using light taiko percussion, shamisen accents, pizzicato strings, and energetic electronic drums. Begin with overly dramatic competitive music during the opening stare-down, accelerate lightly during the eating contest, then stop completely when both spoons reach the final strawberry. After <Subject 1>'s premature victory, play a very short triumphant fanfare that abruptly cuts off when the camera reveals the parfait is still more than half full. End with a tiny comedic musical sting.

Create a 3:4 vertical portrait with an early-digital studio-photo character, featuring a clearly adult young woman sitting directly on the floor of an almost pure-white studio. Use a seamless white sweep or extremely minimal white wall and floor, with no furniture or complex decoration. Position her slightly right of center and keep the tall black bunny ears, folded legs and shoes all visible.

She has short layered dusty mauve-brown to cool rose-brown hair, somewhere between an airy bob and a light shag, with wispy separated bangs falling across the forehead and side pieces flipping naturally outward. The hair should feel slightly tousled and lightweight rather than precisely salon-styled. Her eyes appear pale gray-green to aqua-green. Tilt her head gently toward one shoulder and let her look upward toward the camera from beneath the fringe.

Use cool translucent makeup inspired by Japanese alternative fashion, gothic-cute styling and retro character photography: ivory-to-pale-pink skin, gray-brown or muted rose-brown eyeshadow, thin black eyeliner slightly extending the outer corners, defined but restrained lashes, minimal blush and cool pink to dusty-rose lips. One hand rises near her mouth with naturally curled fingers, obscuring part of the lips as though she is suppressing a smile or pausing in a slightly shy, playful gesture. Keep the facial emotion quiet, restrained and faintly mysterious rather than theatrically seductive.

Dress her in a classic black-and-white bunny-girl-inspired outfit: a black strapless fitted bodysuit, a separate crisp white collar with a black bow tie, and stiff white French-style cuffs with small gold-colored cuff links. Add a pair of tall narrow matte-black bunny ears that tilt in slightly different directions.

Her legs wear medium-transparency semi-sheer black tights, allowing subtle visibility of pale leg skin, knees and muscle form beneath a smoky charcoal layer. She sits directly on the floor with the torso folding slightly inward and forward. Both legs are raised and tightly folded, bent and crossed in front of the body: one thigh passes prominently across the center while the other knee lifts behind it, creating overlapping diagonals and triangular shapes. Preserve slight physical awkwardness and genuine balance tension rather than creating a perfectly symmetrical catalog pose.

The footwear is essential: use black pointed-toe stilettos, but keep only one shoe on her foot. The other foot remains covered only by the black tights. Place the second stiletto separately in the lower-left corner of the frame, where it becomes a strong independent black graphic shape balancing the central figure. A pale nude-colored sole may be visible on the raised shoe.

Visible skin is concentrated on the face, neck, shoulders, collarbones, upper arms, forearms and hands, while leg skin remains visible only through the tights. Keep chest, buttocks and intimate areas fully covered. Use very light neutral-cool ivory skin with subtle pale-pink variation. The skin should look as though it would feel soft, fine-grained, lightly powdery and semi-matte with realistic surface resistance, not like smooth plastic. Preserve subtle redness and tiny tonal irregularities across the shoulders and arms. The tights make the legs visually smoother and more uniform.

Use a large diffused source from camera-left/front and slightly above, combined with strong bounce from the white wall and floor. This produces very soft illumination across the face, shoulders, arms and legs. Retain pale gray shadowing on the figure's right side and inside the overlapping legs so the body keeps dimensional structure. Avoid hard direct flash, strong rim light or cinematic contrast.

Photograph with the character of an early digital camera, small portrait studio or cosplay photo set, using roughly a 35–50mm full-frame-equivalent focal length. Keep the camera around upper-torso to face height and angle it downward approximately 5–15 degrees. The face, hand, foreground legs and stilettos should remain substantially sharp. The background appears smooth because it contains almost no visual detail, not because of extreme shallow depth of field.

Allow the white background to carry a very slight cool gray or cyan cast rather than becoming mathematically pure white. Preserve mild digital grain, modest edge sharpening, slightly hot highlights and simple color processing. A few flyaway hairs, mildly uneven stocking transparency around stretched knees and thighs, and imperfect shoe placement help preserve the early-internet character-photo realism.

Emotionally, it should feel as though she had already completed several bunny-costume portraits in the white studio, then casually sat down on the floor, removed one heel and shifted into a more compact and playful pose. Her hand has just lifted near her lips, and she may adjust her folded legs again immediately after the photograph. Keep the final energy playful, cool, retro-digital and “sweet but not innocent,” without increasing nudity.

Use the image only as a character-design reference. The white background, sheet layout, multiple views, and headings are not part of the video. Show only one instance of this character.
detailed_description:
High-detail 2D animated illustration matching the reference character's visual style, with smooth, restrained acting and consistent clothing details. The setting is a quiet Japanese convenience-store entrance at night. Warm interior light contrasts with cool blue street lighting. The entrance has two transparent glass panels that slide horizontally apart. Keep the same entrance, lighting, and spatial layout throughout. The humor comes from her serious expression and the door's refusal to cooperate. No supernatural effects.

[Shot 1]
A slightly low-angle, three-quarter exterior medium-wide shot shows <Subject 1> on the left and the closed automatic entrance on the right. Her face is visible in profile, and the glass-panel seam is clearly visible. She takes two confident steps toward the entrance, both hands in her jacket pockets, chin slightly raised, looking exceptionally cool and composed. She stops about 40 centimeters in front of the glass, directly beneath the overhead sensor. The door remains completely closed. She waits for a brief beat, then slowly looks up at the sensor. Her confidence shifts into quiet confusion. A short, dramatic electronic bass phrase accompanies her approach, then abruptly stops when the door fails to open. Footsteps and faint street ambience remain.

<Subject 1> remains in front of the same closed door. Without smiling, she removes her right hand from her pocket and waves it twice beneath the sensor. Nothing happens. She pauses, stares at the sensor, then makes ONE small vertical hop with both boots briefly leaving the pavement. She lands naturally in the same spot. The door still does not move. Her jacket and accessories settle after the landing. She lowers her hand, holds a stiff, dignified posture, and gives the glass a mildly offended stare. Keep each action separate and clearly readable. The audio consists of a quiet sleeve rustle, one soft landing thud, and street ambience.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, cut to a slightly wider exterior view of the same doorway.
<Subject 1> shifts half a step to the left, remaining outside beside the entrance with her face visible. One ordinary adult customer in a plain brown jacket and blue jeans enters from the right and approaches the center of the doorway at a normal walking pace. <Subject 1> freezes for a short beat and looks from the open doorway toward the departing customer. Her expression stays mostly serious, with only a tiny eyebrow twitch revealing embarrassment. She puts her right hand back into her pocket, straightens her posture, and casually follows the customer through the still-open entrance as if that had been her plan all along. End at 15 seconds with her entering the store. Keep both characters separate, with natural walking and no overlapping bodies.
overall_soundscape:
Quiet nighttime street ambience, subdued ventilation hum, natural footsteps, clothing rustle, one small-hop landing, and the sliding-door motor. The entry chime occurs only when the ordinary customer activates the door in Shot 3. Both characters remain silent throughout: no dialogue, narration, singing, vocal reactions, or intelligible background speech.

A brief instrumental electronic bass phrase during the confident approach in Shot 1, stopping abruptly when the door stays closed. No music during her failed attempts. One soft, dry pizzicato note punctuates her embarrassed pause in Shot 3. No vocals.
Keep the original costume graphics intact. Add no captions, subtitles, title cards, watermarks, or branded store signage. No additional pedestrians, character duplicates, extra cuts, camera shake, glass collisions, forced entry, or door opening before Shot 3.

[00:13-00:15] HE SEES HER

At approximately 00:13, @Image2 casually turns his head while still seated and looks across the restaurant.

His eyes find the girlfriend.

His expression changes immediately.

The relaxed smile disappears.

His body becomes completely still.

His hand remains near @Image3's hand for a fraction of a second before instinctively pulling away.

The sequence must feel like an authentic continuation of a private smartphone recording rather than a professionally produced cheating scene. 3.5–5.5s — Oil and onions hit the hot pot. Strong sizzling, golden sparkle, steam toward camera. Curved text 「ジュワァァッ！」 rises with steam and dissolves. B smells the aroma, eyes brighten.

5.5–7.5s — Overhead shot. Vegetables tumble into pot. B throws curry spices toward camera; spice particles create a match-cut transition. Bold text 「SPICE!」 and 「香り爆発！」 briefly orbit the pot.

7.5–10.0s — Stock is poured in. Macro shot of thick glossy curry simmering with carrots and potatoes. A stirs with wooden spoon. Slow circular camera move. 「コトコト…」 appears like bubbles, rises and disappears. B watches impatiently.

10.0–12.0s — A lifts a spoon toward camera. Extreme close-up of thick curry dripping in a glossy ribbon, brief slow motion. Giant kinetic countdown:
「3」「2」「1」
Each number punches in on the beat.

12.0–14.0s — Hero reveal. White rice on plate. A pours steaming curry over rice in slow motion. Beautiful sauce flow; visible meat, carrot and potato. Camera pushes close. Elegant title: 「いただきます！」 Small text: “JAPANESE CURRY”.

14.0–15.0s — B takes one bite, eyes widen and says clearly: 「うまっ！！」 A smiles proudly. Final 「うまっ！！」 bounces hard on impact. End on steaming curry close-up with both smiling in background.

AUDIO:
Upbeat funky Japanese cooking-show music, rhythmic chopping, sizzling oil, bubbling curry, stirring, kitchen ambience. Typography impacts perfectly synced to sound.

IMPORTANT:
Prioritize appetizing food cinematography and readable motion graphics equally. No random floating text, unreadable letters, broken hands, extra fingers, duplicated utensils, ingredient morphing, costume changes, character fusion or continuity errors.

Her hips remain turned away from the camera while her waist, ribcage and head twist naturally toward frame right. She looks sideways past her shoulder rather than into the lens, her lips slightly parted and her expression quiet, relaxed and subtly aloof, as though she has just heard someone call her from behind.  She wears a bright cobalt or royal-blue baseball cap with a broad brim and only a very small orange-red embroidered detail. The brim creates a soft, physically believable shadow near her eyes. Her hair is deep black to black-brown, tied into a low ponytail, with a few loose face-framing strands. The long ponytail ends fall into broad, relaxed curves and flick slightly outward, retaining natural weight, movement and a few imperfect flyaways rather than looking perfectly styled.  Preserve a slim, soft facial structure, delicate jawline, natural side-profile nose and small relaxed lips. Makeup is extremely light and translucent, inspired by clean East Asian fashion-editorial beauty: sheer foundation with faint natural texture still visible, soft apricot-peach blush, very subtle eyeliner, light lashes, nearly invisible eyeshadow, and muted nude-pink or pale coral lips. No heavy contouring and no exaggerated influencer-style facial redesign.  She wears a white short-sleeve baseball jersey with thin blue vertical pinstripes, slightly loose through the upper torso and gathered, rolled or lightly tied around the waist to create a cropped effect. Add a small red-and-blue baseball-inspired letter patch on the chest without reproducing legible brand typography. The pinstripes must bend realistically around the torso twist, and the fabric should bunch and wrinkle naturally around the waist.  Pair it with deep indigo frayed denim cut-off shorts, featuring golden-brown stitching, curved rear-pocket seams, distressed rolled edges and irregular loose fibers. The denim should feel thick and real, lightly creased and naturally shaped around the hips without looking vacuum-tight.  Visible skin includes the face, ear, side of the neck, forearms, hands, a narrow strip of side and lower-back skin, and most of the thighs below the shorts. The shoulders, chest and most of the back remain covered, and the buttocks remain covered by denim, with only the upper-thigh edges visible near the frayed hems. Use a bright warm-ivory skin tone with subtle peach and natural circulation. The skin should look fine and soft yet retain faint real texture and tonal variation; visually it should suggest skin that would feel warm, clean and lightly supple to the touch rather than smooth plastic.  The pose should feel caught during a real movement. Most of the body weight rests on one straighter leg while the other leg extends diagonally toward the lower right of the frame, producing a relaxed S-shaped flow through the waist, hips and legs. One hand hangs loosely beside the outer thigh with naturally separated fingers. The other arm reaches toward frame right while lightly holding a white takeaway drink cup with a thin black straw. Tiny minimalist markings may appear on the cup, but they should remain indistinct rather than turning into obvious AI-generated text.  Photograph from slightly behind and to the subject's left, with the camera around chest-to-waist height and only a very mild upward angle. Use the visual character of a full-frame 50-70mm equivalent lens at approximately f/3.5-f/5.6. Frame from the complete top of the cap down to around the mid-to-lower thighs, keeping the extended hand and drink entirely within the composition. Keep the framing slightly off-center and imperfect rather than mathematically balanced.  Use an extremely large diffused white key light positioned roughly 30-45 degrees in front of the subject toward frame right. The seamless white studio and large white bounce surfaces should strongly fill the shadows, pushing the backdrop close to pure white with occasional slight overexposure. Broad, milky, diffused highlights should appear across the cheek, forearms, hand, waist and thighs. Keep only a faint realistic shadow beneath the cap brim. No hard light, no strong rim light, no colored lighting and no dramatic cinematic backlight.  The image should be high resolution without aggressive sharpening or HDR. Retain extremely fine digital softness or subtle grain, natural flyaway hairs, garment bunching, irregular denim frays, imperfect finger alignment and slight shifts in body weight. The overall aesthetic is 90s/00s baseball-inspired casual fashion blended with clean East Asian editorial styling: bright, summery, sporty and effortless, with a slight emotional distance from the camera.  She had just turned around; the drink is still moving slightly in her hand. Right now her body is suspended in that brief turning moment, and in the next second she seems ready to keep walking. Prompt:

Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster built around the interaction between portrait photography, typography, structure, and physical space.

Subject: [male / female fashion model]
Outfit: [minimal tailoring / black fashion / white suit / structured styling]
Palette: [black + acid lime / ivory + burgundy / black + teal / custom palette]
Title: [TITLE]
Design direction: [oversized type / acrylic frame / vertical slicing / structural layout]

Start with a strong fashion photograph: realistic skin, refined facial features, expressive pose, detailed fabric, controlled studio lighting, and premium magazine quality.

Then make the graphic design physically interact with the subject instead of simply placing text around the portrait.

Directions:

• Oversized type × figure
Use extremely large typography that extends beyond the canvas. Let the subject pass in front of some letters and behind others, creating foreground/background depth.

• Acrylic form × spatial layering
Introduce a transparent glass or acrylic frame with visible thickness, reflections, edge highlights and subtle refraction. Let the subject touch, enter or intersect the structure.

• Vertical slices × portrait
Reconstruct one portrait through 4–5 unequal vertical image sections with visible gaps and subtle positional shifts. Keep the main facial features readable and attractive.

• Fashion × structural layout
Use a strong fashion pose, geometric color fields, oversized typography and architectural framing. Let the body, furniture, color blocks and type form one unified composition.

Keep typography bold but controlled: one dominant title, one short supporting phrase and minimal micro-text.

Use asymmetrical composition, strong scale contrast, intentional negative space, layering, cropping and selective color accents.

The final image should feel like a premium fashion campaign, experimental magazine cover or contemporary exhibition key visual.

Letting my heart lead the way, no matter how stormy it gets. ☁️✨

**PROMPT**
Vertical hero-shot composite: a woman with the face from the reference photo stands on top of a jagged rock pinnacle high among storm clouds, both arms raised in a double-bicep flex, elbows out and fists clenched at head height — a closed symmetrical silhouette forming an inverted triangle that reads as strength and triumph even at thumbnail size. Wardrobe (womenswear): an oversized washed forest-green hooded sweatshirt with a heavy pigment-dyed fade, a large hand-lettered cream script reading "Let your heart lead the way" across the chest, small embroidered sun, star and red rose motifs scattered over the chest and sleeves, matching script running down both sleeves, a kangaroo pocket and hood down; extremely wide-leg white knee-length denim shorts with a large blue-and-grey Japanese koi-and-wave illustration printed across the right leg, and a silver chain hanging from the belt loop; tall scrunched white ribbed crew socks; white leather Air Force-style low-top sneakers; and black wraparound sunglasses with dark opaque lenses. Hair: long jet-black hair, thick and messy on top with a spiky textured fringe falling forward over the brow, the rest falling loosely past the shoulders and catching slight wind at the ends. Camera: extreme low angle from below the rock, the figure cut out against open sky with nothing surrounding her, centered on the vertical axis and occupying the upper two thirds — that low angle is what converts an ordinary pose into a heroic one, enlarging the torso, foreshortening the legs and placing the viewer beneath the subject. Lighting: frontal-upper flash with medium diffusion — a hard glint sliding across the dark sunglass lenses, short shadows beneath the raised arms, pronounced modelling in the heavy fleece folds, and no side fill so the flanks of the body fall to dark values and the silhouette cuts cleanly against the brighter sky; the sky's brightest area sits upper right and the rim light on the shoulders matches that direction. Sky: dense layered storm cumulus in blue-grey and green-grey, visible painterly texture, high contrast between the lit volumes and the shadowed masses, graded toward cyan with overall saturation pulled down — the atmosphere of an incoming storm. Grade: desaturated and cool through the sky and rock, set against the muted warm green of the sweatshirt and the bright white block of the shorts — that opposition being the chromatic engine of the image; dense blacks, medium-high contrast, fine grain. Palette: blue-grey sky dominating absolutely, dark rock as the anchor, forest green as the single sustained colour holding the upper body, the white shorts and socks as the brightest values placed at the exact center of the frame where they hold all the attention, and the cream lettering and red rose motifs as small warm accents.

Rewrite the user's text, image, or both as a prompt for GPT Image Gen V2 or Nano Banana Pro. Use GPT unless Nano is named. Write in the user's language, preserve text, and keep the requested or source ratio.

Use three systems. Occlusion Core makes the subject block one dominant light source and remain readable through silhouette, posture, face planes, clothing, or structure. Escape Edge records where that source passes around hair, skin, fabric, glass, metal, or object rims. Site Return uses a location surface to send weaker light back into the shadow side.

Do not make a generic rim-lit portrait, night-city poster, or cutout. Determine the subject, source, blocking form, edge path, return surface, revealed planes, junctions, and a quiet region.

Preserve subject, count, identity, action, setting, clothing, objects, colors, text, and reference roles. For edits, preserve unrequested content. Use style references only for source occlusion, edge escape, underexposure, environmental return, crop, and depth. Do not copy faces, outfits, locations, or poses.

The source needs position, size, color, and direction. The subject blocks most of it. Edge light appears only on source-facing contours and breaks where hair density, anatomy, clothing, or objects interrupt it. No full glowing outline.

Return light comes from the setting and stays weaker than the source. It may reveal one eye, cheek, jaw, hand, garment plane, or object face. Water gives broken reflections. Stone gives broad low fill. Glass and metal give narrow highlights. Matte fabric absorbs most light. Skin keeps local color and does not glow.

Use one blocking anchor, one edge route, one return surface, one focal junction and a quiet area. Flare, haze, or light shafts require the source to enter the lens or particles to cross the beam.

Remove repetition, praise, mood labels, prestige terms, and unresolved alternatives. Use concrete nouns and active verbs. No em dash or en dash.

GPT: return 500 to 800 words in five paragraphs covering scene, subjects, Occlusion Core, Escape Edge, Site Return, junctions, composition, preservation, text, and failures.

NANO: return JSON only, 1000 to 1800 tokens, using "aspect_ratio", "references", "scene", "subjects", "occlusion_core", "escape_edge", "site_return", "relay_junctions", "composition", "optics_and_material", "text", "avoid". Omit unused fields. No metadata, IDs, weights, comments, or repetition.

Return only the finished prompt.

prompts.text:
Prompt:

Profession or hobby: [ ]
Subject: [adult man/woman, appearance and personality]
Outfit: [ ]
Natural action or pose: [ ]
Related tools, products, or objects: [ ]
Supporting collage images: [3 related scenes or details]
Main headline: [ ]
Secondary title: [ ]
Brand / editorial information: [ ]
Accent color: [ ]
Aspect ratio: [3:4]

Create a vertical scrapbook-style editorial portrait poster based on the subject’s profession or hobby.

Use a warm ivory textured-paper background with subtle fibers, print grain, and a lightly aged fashion-magazine feel. Place one realistic full-body subject as the dominant cutout, occupying around 60–68% of the composition. Keep the entire body and shoes visible. Add slightly irregular white paper edges and a soft natural paper shadow.

The subject should be performing a small, natural action connected to their profession or hobby rather than standing in a stiff model pose. Use realistic skin texture, natural facial features, expressive eyes, authentic hair, and clearly rendered clothing materials.

Build three supporting collage modules around the subject:

1. One larger environmental or contextual photograph  
2. One black-and-white action or detail photograph  
3. One smaller collage featuring relevant tools, products, materials, or personal objects  

Every supporting image must relate directly to the subject’s identity. Use torn-paper edges, slight rotation, controlled overlap, and subtle shadows. Keep the main subject in natural color while most supporting photographs remain monochrome or softly desaturated.

Add the large handwritten headline “[Main headline]” across the upper section in [accent color]. Add “[Secondary title]” in a smaller handwritten style near the lower area. Include a few clean serif or sans-serif editorial labels using the supplied brand, profession, location, date, product, or material information.

Add restrained hand-drawn arrows, circles, underlines, short notes, measurements, or numbers that help explain the subject’s story. Keep all annotations meaningful and visually controlled.

Maintain 25–30% negative space, one clear visual focus, and a balanced reading path from the headline to the face, outfit, supporting images, and secondary title. The final result should feel like a distinctive personal portrait, fashion editorial, and visual identity profile combined into one poster.
